high.title: Series of Positive Information Emerges, Will VN-Index Soon Conquer the 2,000 Point Mark?
high.summary: An Binh Securities (ABS) reports a relatively positive outlook for Vietnam's stock market in the coming period, with long-term trends continuing upward. After previous corrections, medium-term trends are beginning to show positive technical signals again. Technically, ABS believes VN-Index has successfully created a bottom in the 1,586-1,606 point range, forming a relatively solid support base and creating an upward price structure. Growth momentum is assessed as quite good, while capital flows show signs of support and accumulation in many large stock groups including banking, real estate, securities, steel, and transportation in April. Capital is also beginning to spread to mid and small-cap stocks, which is seen as a positive signal showing the rally is not just concentrated in pillar groups but expanding to more stock layers in the market. This technical analysis suggests potential for VN-Index to approach the 2,000 point psychological level.

high.title: Banks Have Over 168,000 Billion VND in NPLs - First Bank to Cross 30,000 Billion VND in Group 5 Loans
high.summary: Statistics from financial reports of 27 listed banks show total Group 5 loans (NPLs) at March 31, 2026 reached 168,543 billion VND, up 535 billion VND from end-2025. Sacombank leads the system with 30,547 billion VND, increasing by 641 billion VND from year-end, becoming the first Vietnamese bank with Group 5 loans exceeding 30,000 billion VND. BIDV ranks second with 27,540 billion VND, up 1,715 billion VND from end-2025. This development is significant for banking sector health and credit risk assessment. The rapid increase in NPLs at major banks indicates potential stress in loan portfolios and may impact future provisioning requirements, affecting bank profitability and lending capacity. Foreign investors and bond traders should monitor these NPL trends as they directly impact banking sector stability and could influence SBV monetary policy decisions.

high.title: Bank Paying Highest Cash Dividend in 2026 Will Record Ex-Date Next Week
high.summary: LPBank will record shareholders for 2025 cash dividend distribution on May 15, 2026. With a 30% dividend rate (3,000 VND per share), LPBank will pay approximately 8,962 billion VND to shareholders, making it the bank with the highest cash dividend rate in the system for 2026. Payment is scheduled for May 25, 2026. This positions LPBank among the rare few maintaining a purely cash dividend policy at large scale. In 2025, the bank also paid 25% cash dividend equivalent to 7,468 billion VND. This aggressive dividend policy signals strong capital position and profitability, which is positive for equity investors but may indicate limited growth investment opportunities or excess capital that could otherwise support lending growth.

medium.title: SBV: LDR Ratios of BIDV, VietinBank, Vietcombank, Agribank Near Maximum Threshold
medium.summary: The State Bank of Vietnam has released a draft amendment to Circular 22/2019 regarding safety limits and ratios for bank operations. A notable change is shifting from "loan-to-deposit ratio" (LDR) to "credit-to-mobilized capital ratio" (CDR), expanding the calculation base beyond just loans and deposits to include total credit extension and mobilized capital.

medium.title: Not Big4 Group, This is the Bank That Attracted Most Customer Deposits in Q1/2026
medium.summary: HDBank became the bank with strongest deposit growth system-wide in Q1, with customer deposits reaching 621,549 billion VND at March 31, 2026, up over 60,834 billion VND from end-2025 (nearly 11% growth). This represents the highest growth rate across the banking sector in Q1 and the largest absolute deposit increase, surpassing many large state-owned banks.

medium.title: One Vietnamese Bank Has Closed 126 Transaction Offices
medium.summary: VietinBank continued closing transaction offices in Q1/2026, ending March with 157 branches and 827 transaction offices, down 18 offices from end-2025. Combined with 108 office closures in 2025, VietinBank has shuttered 126 transaction offices over the past year while maintaining strong Q1/2026 results with pre-tax profit of over 11,100 billion VND, up 63% year-on-year.

medium.title: Gold Prices Rise on Export Markets
medium.summary: Rice and paddy prices in the Mekong Delta mostly increased due to scarce supply at the end of harvest season. Vietnam's export rice prices also jumped amid global market concerns about El Niño's impact on worldwide supply, with fragrant rice averaging 6,114 VND/kg and regular rice at 5,754 VND/kg.

medium.title: Evening 11/5: SJC Gold and Ring Gold Prices Drop Sharply Following Global Trends
medium.summary: On evening of May 11, SJC and other gold companies traded SJC gold bars at 162.2-165.2 million VND/tael, down 2.3 million VND/tael from morning. Gold rings traded at 161.7-164.7 million VND/tael, also down 2.3 million VND/tael. Domestic gold prices fell as global gold retreated from $4,700/ounce to $4,676/ounce amid USD and crude oil recovery.
